concerns.text: FR-001 and FR-002 require downloading WESAD and scanning OpenNeuro metadata. Task T011 covers the metadata scan, but there is NO task explicitly implementing the WESAD download from Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.1292932) or the local scan of BIDS events.tsv files for the 'Schandry' task label as mandated by FR-002. T012 is unchecked and describes the scan, but T011 explicitly forbids downloading the full archive, leaving the 'download' requirement of FR-001 unassigned to any active task.

FR-006 and Plan 'Project Structure' require `code/04_update_state.py` to compute SHA-256 hashes and update `state/projects/...yaml`. Task T007 describes this logic but is marked unchecked `[ ]` and listed in the 'Rejected' section of the analyze report. No active task covers the implementation of the versioning state update required by Constitution Principle V.

FR-001 and Plan 'Project Structure' require validation against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. Task T004 describes the error contract for schema validation but is marked unchecked `[ ]` and listed as 'Rejected'. No active task implements the schema validation logic or the specific error handling (exit code 1, timeout > 60s) required by FR-001/T004.

FR-002 requires scanning local BIDS `events.tsv` files for 'Schandry' or 'heartbeat' task labels. Task T012 covers this logic but is unchecked `[ ]`. Task T011 only performs a metadata-only scan. Without T012 being active, the system cannot verify the presence of the specific behavioral task as required by FR-002.

FR-003 requires computing HRV metrics (RMSSD, SDNN) for baseline and stress phases. Task T022 covers this logic but is unchecked `[ ]`. Task T020 loads data, but without T022 active, the core metric computation is missing. T021 (cleaning) and T023 (extraction) are also unchecked, leaving the entire US2 implementation incomplete.

FR-005 requires linear regression analysis. Task T032 covers the primary logic but is unchecked `[ ]`. T029 (script implementation), T030 (data check), T031 (MDES fallback), and T033 (report generation) are all unchecked. The entire US3 implementation is missing active tasks.

SC-004 requires measuring pipeline execution time against GitHub Actions limits. Task T038 covers timing instrumentation but is unchecked `[ ]`. No active task ensures the pipeline meets the 15-minute (audit) and 45-minute (full) constraints.

Task T002 contains a template placeholder `{{claim:c_208d3e66}}` and a Wikipedia link for 'History of Python' which is irrelevant to initializing a data analysis project. This is a stale template artifact that should be removed or replaced with a relevant project initialization claim.

Task T016 requires validating the report against a 'full WESAD dataset' scan, but T011 explicitly forbids downloading the full archive to meet the 15-minute limit. This creates a logical contradiction where T016 describes an impossible action. The task description needs revision to align with the metadata-only constraint or the download requirement.
